title: Caitlin Clark's Message About Swifties Proves Taylor Swift's Power Is Unmatched - NewsBreak
text: WNBA star Caitlin Clark joined a passionate wave of Swifties as they tuned in to Taylor Swift’s guest appearance in New Heights . Hosted by retired NFL star Jason Kelce and her boyfriend, Travis Kelce, the pop star’s podcast debut not only caused a major frenzy among fans but also sparked a social media wildfire. On Wednesday, the music sensation officially announced her new album, The Life of a Showgirl , with the highly anticipated release date set for October 3. The 12th studio album marks the conclusion of her widely successful Eras Tour as well as the final chapter of her journey to fully reclaim her master recordings. Besides discussing the process of creating and producing the upcoming album, Swift also talked about her career, her relationship with the Kansas City Chiefs star, her family and more. Amid all this excitement, the world tuned in to the podcast, sparking millions of views globally. “I mean, this video being 1.3 million views is the epitome of numerology,” the elder Kelce posted. As mentioned, among those who tuned in was the Indiana Fever star, who praised the Swifties for their massive influence. Moreover, she called them “powerful” for their ability to generate huge online buzz. “Swifties so powerful we broke the internet,” she wrote in her response to her earlier post, which read, “Are we sure YouTube isn’t going to crash tonight?” The post received positive reactions from the public, especially from the Swifties who celebrated their collective power and showed love for the WNBA star. “Love that you are one of us,” one wrote. A follower playfully commented, saying , “I don’t know about you, but I’m feeling 22…” referring to the pop icon’s song and Clark’s jersey number. Others even pointed out the skyrocketing view count in real time, proving the reach of Swifties around the world. “Numbers are still climbing—over 2M viewers right now,” a fan said. This is not the first time that Clark delivered a major fangirl moment. The Fever guard attended the Eras Tour multiple times, including two consecutive nights at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.
